title: Adaptive Linear Networks for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting in Big Data Systems
abstract: arXiv:2505.00590v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale sensing, clinical, transportation, energy, and climate systems often produce irregular multivariate time series with sparse observations, heterogeneous sampling intervals, and asynchronous variables. Forecasting at externally supplied future query coordinates requires a model to accommodate variable observation lengths and time locations while retaining efficient variable interaction. We present AiT (Adaptive inverted Transformer), whose ALinear (Adaptive Linear) module generates sample-adaptive temporal weights from observation or query coordinates. More precisely, ALinear is time-conditioned attention pooling without value projection. Available observation or query coordinates generate the corresponding keys or queries, the fixed-shape counterpart may use learned default slots, and the unprojected inputs serve as values. translated_title: 大数据系统中不规则多变量时间序列预测的自适应线性网络
translated_abstract: 大规模传感、临床、交通、能源和气候系统通常会产生观测稀疏、采样间隔异构且变量不同步的不规则多变量时间序列。在外部给定的未来查询坐标上进行预测，要求模型能够适应可变的观测长度和时间位置，同时保持高效的变量交互。我们提出了AiT（Adaptive inverted Transformer，自适应反转Transformer），其ALinear（Adaptive Linear，自适应线性）模块能够从观测或查询坐标生成样本自适应的时间权重。更准确地说，ALinear是一种无需值投影的时间条件化注意力池化。可用的观测或查询坐标生成相应的键或查询，固定形状的对应部分可以使用学习到的默认槽位，而未经投影的输入则作为值。因此，“线性”这一名称仅指最终的加权和输出形式，而并非等同于……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AiT模型，其核心ALinear模块通过无需值投影的时间条件化注意力池化，从观测或查询坐标生成样本自适应的时间权重，从而在不规则多变量时间序列的任意查询坐标上实现高效且灵活的预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AiT, whose ALinear module—a time-conditioned attention pooling without value projection—generates sample-adaptive temporal weights from observation or query coordinates, enabling efficient forecasting of irregular multivariate time series at arbitrary query coordinates.
